review_note: The official state hazard-mitigation plan identifies EO 2003-09 as severe storms and flooding

Claims Journal, May 15, 2006: 'Governor John Lynch declared a state of emergency in New Hampshire.' The report gives no signing day, so its own date is used; an AP story printed by the Bangor Daily News says he declared on Sunday, May 14.

Atlantic News, Friday, April 20, 2007 (Lane Memorial Library archive): 'Gov. John Lynch, who visited the areas of Hampton and Newmarket on Tuesday, declared a state of emergency Monday.' Monday was April 16, 2007.

Claims Journal, July 25, 2008: 'New Hampshire Gov. John Lynch declared a state of emergency' in Belknap, Carroll, Merrimack, Strafford and Rockingham counties. The report gives no signing day, so its own date is used.
